name: vfx.text.apply
summary: Apply typed effect text as reversible graph ops.

examples.json:
{
  "cmd": "vfx.text.apply",
  "args": {
    "source": "{
  "name": "campfire",
  "seed": 17,
  "hz": 60,
  "quality": {
    "particles": 1000000,
    "overdraw": 16,
    "lights": 8,
    "events": 4096
  },
  "emitters": [
    {
      "name": "flame",
      "capacity": 512,
      "bounds": {
        "min": [-8, -2, -8],
        "max": [8, 12, 8]

      "stacks": {
        "spawn": [
          {
            "name": "rate",
            "module": {
              "op": "rate",
              "per_second": 80
            }
          }
        ],
        "initialize": [
          {
            "name": "lifetime",
            "module": {
              "op": "lifetime",
              "seconds": 0.85,
              "size": 0.3,
              "color": [5, 0.6, 0.03, 0.5]
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "hearth",
            "module": {
              "op": "sphere",

              "radius": 0.2

              "op": "velocity",

        "update": [
          {
            "name": "curl",
            "module": {
              "op": "curl_noise",
              "frequency": 3,
              "strength": 0.55

          },
          {
            "name": "drag",
            "module": {
              "op": "drag",
              "coefficient": 0.6
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "fade",
            "module": {
              "op": "color_over_life",
              "keys": [
                {
                  "t": 0,
                  "value": [4, 1.6, 0.35, 0]
                },
                {
                  "t": 0.1,
                  "value": [4, 1.5, 0.25, 0.75]
                },
                {
                  "t": 0.55,
                  "value": [2.6, 0.65, 0.06, 0.5]
                },
                {
                  "t": 1,
                  "value": [0.4, 0.04, 0, 0]
                }
              ]
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "shrink",
            "module": {
              "op": "size_over_life",
              "keys": [
                {
                  "t": 0,
                  "value": 0.24
                },
                {
                  "t": 0.35,
                  "value": 0.34
                },
                {
                  "t": 1,
                  "value": 0.08
                }
              ]
            }
          }
        ],
        "render": [
          {
            "name": "sprite",
            "module": {
              "op": "sprite",
              "domain": "unlit",
              "soft_distance": 0.15,
              "sorting": "none"
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "appearance",
            "module": {
              "op": "appearance",
              "texture": "fire",
              "blend": "additive",
              "alignment": "camera",
              "stretch": 1,
              "shutter": 0
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "flipbook",
            "module": {
              "op": "flipbook",
              "grid": [4, 4],
              "fps": 16
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "hearth_light",
            "module": {
              "op": "light",
              "color": [1, 0.32, 0.055],
              "lumens": 900,
              "radius": 6
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "smoke",
      "capacity": 2048,
      "bounds": {
        "min": [-8, -2, -8],
        "max": [8, 12, 8]
      },
      "stacks": {
        "spawn": [
          {
            "name": "rate",

              "op": "rate",
              "per_second": 12
            }
          }
        ],
        "initialize": [
          {
            "name": "lifetime",

          {

          {
            "name": "curl",

            }
          },
          {

              "op": "size_over_life",
              "keys": [
                {
                  "t": 0,
                  "value": 0.25
                },
                {

                  "value": 1
                }
              ]
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "fade",
            "module": {
              "op": "color_over_life",
              "keys": [
                {
                  "t": 0,
                  "value": [0.1, 0.095, 0.09, 0]
                },
                {
                  "t": 0.15,
                  "value": [0.12, 0.115, 0.11, 0.2]
                },
                {
                  "t": 0.6,
                  "value": [0.16, 0.16, 0.16, 0.11]
                },
                {
                  "t": 1,
                  "value": [0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0]
                }
              ]
            }
          }
        ],
        "render": [
          {
            "name": "sprite",
            "module": {
              "op": "sprite",
              "domain": "surface",
              "soft_distance": 0.3,
              "sorting": "depth"

          },
          {
            "name": "appearance",
            "module": {
              "op": "appearance",
              "texture": "smoke",
              "blend": "alpha",
              "alignment": "camera",
              "stretch": 1,
              "shutter": 0
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "flipbook",
            "module": {
              "op": "flipbook",
              "grid": [4, 4],
              "fps": 16
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "embers",
      "capacity": 4096,
      "bounds": {
        "min": [-8, -2, -8],
        "max": [8, 12, 8]
      },
      "stacks": {
        "spawn": [
          {
            "name": "rate",
            "module": {
              "op": "rate",
              "per_second": 12
            }
          }
        ],
        "initialize": [
          {
            "name": "lifetime",
            "module": {
              "op": "lifetime",

            }
          },
          {
            "name": "source",
            "module": {
              "op": "point",

            }
          },
          {
            "name": "spray",

          {
            "name": "sprite",

            }

  ]
